---
title: Build with masks
description: The technical pages, for developers who connect apps to masks and operators who run it.
---

These pages are for developers and operators. They name endpoints, scopes, environment variables,
and the words in the code. The plain-language pages for the people who run masks and sign in
through it are under [Use masks](/use/).

## Get started

- [Quickstart](/build/quickstart/) runs masks from its container image or its repository, and
  connects a first app.
- [Core concepts](/build/core-concepts/) explains tenants, actors, clients, scopes, namespaces,
  and signing keys.
- [Demo](/build/demo/) runs two tenants side by side.

## Run masks

- [Self-hosting](/build/self-hosting/) is the full operator guide: Postgres, the master key,
  replicas, metrics, backups, tenants, custom domains, and apps declared in a file.
- [Manage](/build/manage/) says where everything lives in `/manage`.
- [Security](/build/security/) covers tenant isolation, manage roles, rate limits, risky
  sign-ins, and the protocol features that harden a client.
- [Themes](/build/themes/) styles the sign-in and account pages.

## Sign people in

- [Features](/build/features/) covers clients, signing in, signing out, groups, and accounts.
- [Organizations](/build/organizations/) covers what apps read about organizations.
- [Single sign-on and SAML](/build/sso-saml/), [LDAP](/build/ldap/), and
  [Enterprise](/build/enterprise/) connect providers, directories, and legacy apps.

## Connect your apps

- [Connecting via SDK](/build/connecting-via-sdk/) picks an SDK and registers an app.
- [Forward authentication](/build/forward-auth/) signs people in to any app behind Caddy,
  Traefik, or nginx.

## Send events

- [Event streams](/build/event-streams/) send each sign-in and change to a URL you choose.
- [Shared signals](/build/shared-signals/) tell apps when a session ends.

## Reference

- [OpenID Connect and OAuth](/reference/specs/) lists the specifications masks implements.
- [Environment variables](/reference/environment/) lists every variable the server reads.
- [Manage API](/reference/manage/) is the GraphQL API behind `/manage`.
- SDKs for [JavaScript](/reference/javascript/), [Python](/reference/python/),
  [Go](/reference/go/), and [Ruby](/reference/ruby/).
